records.part: Desktop 3D firearm scanner with GelSight-based imaging and analysis system for firearm forensics
records.reason: The Cadre TopMatch-3D system is capable of scanning up to 15 cartridge cases in one batch and uses a proprietary electromagnetic gel-pad to address issues associated with scanning reflective metal surfaces.

records.part: Portable 3D firearm scanner with GelSight-based imaging and analysis system for firearm forensics
records.reason: The gel-pad itself is patented technology (GelSight\u00ae) and offers resolution needed to differentiate fine striations.
